args.name: Lantern Night — 14 November 2026 — Willow Park Bristol

style.prompt: Create an 8-second vertical event promo, 9:16, silent, no voiceover, no audio. Cinematic night-time scene in a leafy park after dark, warm amber glowing paper lanterns suspended safely from tree branches, subtle lantern swaying and twinkling reflections, deep midnight blue background, inviting magical atmosphere. One continuous slow gentle camera push forward. No daylight, no fire releases, no logos. Most important: prominent perfectly legible event typography, not small background signage. Keep a dark uncluttered central area behind the text. From the very first frame through the final frame display the following exact three lines as a stable centered graphic overlay with no movement or morphing: 'LANTERN NIGHT' / '14 NOVEMBER 2026' / 'WILLOW PARK, BRISTOL'. Large bold clean cream-white sans-serif typography with high contrast and ample spacing. Date and venue should be especially large and easy to read on a phone. Fit all text comfortably within the central safe area, never crop any letters. Lanterns frame the text along the edges. Hold all event information clearly on screen for all eight seconds.
